item.title: Living the truth in the simple things
item.description: At our men’s group this morning we spent time looking at truth. My notes finished with a simple thought: live the truth in the simple things. Looking back over the passages we discussed, that feels like the thread that holds them together. There is plenty to explore about what truth means, but there is also a personal question running through it: how does what I believe shape the way I live?
